title: First Contact
summary: Variables, lists, len() and sum(), counting from 0, and numpy.
hints: `n = len(hours)` and `total = sum(hours)`; then `mean_hours = total / n`.
The first item is `hours[0]`. The last two are `hours[-2:]` (or `hours[3:5]`: the end position is left out).
`import numpy as np` once at the top, then `np_mean = np.mean(hours)`.
